title: The Bell That Grew Leaves
shortDescription: When fog rolls in, the village has to answer without making a sound.
description:
A neighboring village has rung across the fog. Your own bell gives a sound no bigger than a pebble. Trace an old trick through the reed store and the spring, then help a very stubborn bell find a voice that can travel without sound.

An original fantasy adventure for ages 8 and up, with no countdown or permanent mistakes.
author: Studio Null
